## 席位意见(增量)· director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`), read as batch #366 item 1, 2026-10-19T00:08Z

On the epic PM's decision card (Q1 A · Q2 A · Q3 A · Q4 A recommended; fallbacks Q1 B · Q2 B · Q3 C · Q4 B), filed from the stage 8b-0b measurement on #24343. The maintainer's words in this session's chat: 「继续决裁」.

**Premises re-run in this act — objectstack `origin/main` `44a5011fe623`, cloud `9099bd1ea646`:**
1. `settleSelfRegistrationGrant` exists (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:5670`). Holds.
2. The system-insert exemption is still in place (`PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` in `packages/objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts`, 3 hits); stage 8b retires it. Holds.
3. Encrypted settings are declared global (`encrypted: true` in `packages/services/service-settings/src`, present). Holds.
4. PR #24369 (stage 8b-0b: under `single`, every one of these writes names the Default Organization) is merged. Holds — the walled half is what this card decides.
5. **The card's confidence gap, read in cloud this act (the epic seat cannot read cloud):** the control plane declares `selfRegistrationPermissionSet: 'cloud_control_plane_member'` (`packages/service-cloud/src/control-plane-preset.ts:619`, `control-plane-permissions.ts:82`). That set grants reads on `sys_member`, `sys_organization`, `sys_environment`, `sys_domain`, `sys_package_installation`, `sys_audit_log` and `sys_cloud_connection` (`:138`–`:264`), and its header names the console's own read points (`GET /api/v1/data/sys_member?limit=200`, the organisations page). Organisation creation itself goes through better-auth's organization plugin, not a permission set. So the set is not what lets a registrant create their first organisation; it is what lets the console's pages read between sign-up and that first organisation. Q1 A therefore does not break creation, but it does leave a registrant with no set in that window, and whether the console tolerates a 403 on those reads there is the measurement the cloud seat owes — under Q1 B the window is the same, so the measurement decides a cloud follow-up (the console's pre-organisation reads tolerate no set, or the grant lands at creation), not the letter.

**Facets:** ① agree with A · A · A · A — each is a structural rule, all four land on the record's own sentence (a table with no organization column is deployment-level, protected by permissions, not by the wall), and the end state has no 「column present but empty」 third kind; mainstream multi-tenant platforms keep identity and platform rows in tables of their own; the B / C variants keep an exception list or leave the refusal to runtime · ② the pull is the walled control plane: every sign-up writes the four kinds (the #24343 census), and C10 (cloud#1979) meets it; `single` has none (PR #24369) · ③ A's four rules are each one sentence an author can hold, not a per-template or per-object list; C refuses normal sign-up · ④ all four are reductions (a column dropped, fewer tenant tables, no gate); Q3 the cheapest, Q2 and Q4 the largest and each a D7 amendment (Tier H).

**Recommend Q1 A · Q2 A · Q3 A · Q4 A**, with Q1 executed only after the cloud seat measures the pre-organisation window (premise 5); the fallbacks as the card names them. 口径, binding with the letter: (1) Q1 — the self-registration grant settles when the user joins their first organisation (creating one is joining it as owner); the walled window between sign-up and that moment is measured by the cloud seat before dispatch, and a console read that needs a set there becomes a cloud card, not a reason to keep a deployment-level grant (D3 stands); (2) Q2 — identity mail to the user themself is deployment-level: `sys_email` leaves the tenant-table list for those rows (ADR-0131 D7 amendment, Tier H); (3) Q3 — `sys_activity` is written only for records that carry an organization column; the rest is the deployment ledger's (`sys_audit_log`, D7); (4) Q4 — `sys_secret` drops its organization column (ownership follows the referencing row), the global settings' audit history moves to the deployment level (D7 amendment, Tier H; the ceremony names where the moved rows go). Not taken: the B / C variants (exception lists, refusals of normal sign-up). **Workload:** the card's figures (Q1 0.3–0.6k, Q2 0.5–1k, Q3 0.1–0.2k, Q4 0.8–1.5k lines), each a C8 stage under 3,000 lines, measured first. **Execution:** the epic seat cuts the stages before 8b; the D7 amendment PRs are the maintainer's to approve (Tier H); the director asks the `repo:cloud#2` seat for the premise-5 measurement by a pointer on cloud#1979.

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:同意 A·A·A·A —— 四条都落在记录的那句话上(没有组织列的表就是部署级,靠权限不靠墙),终态没有「有列但空」的第三种;B/C 留例外名单或把断路留给运行时。
- ② 实际业务拉动:带墙的控制面每次注册都写这四类行,C10 迁移前必须定;single 零拉动(PR #24369 已处理)。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 每条是一句能记住的结构性规则,不是逐模板逐对象的清单;C 拒的是正常注册。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:四条都是减法;Q3 最省,Q2、Q4 最大且各需一次 D7 修订(Tier H)。本席在 cloud 读到的第 5 条前提只影响 Q1 的执行时序,不翻字母。

自检:只看①选 A·A·A·A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

## 席位意见(增量 2 · Q2–Q4 深度调研;Q1 实测卡)· director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · on batch #366 item 1, 2026-10-19T00:44Z

The maintainer's words in this session's chat, verbatim: 「24377 需要的话，Q1 你现在就可以派测试 ，cloud 相关任务加到cloud车道。 其他Q问题也帮我深度调研和分析确认。」 Q1's measurement is filed as objectstack-ai/cloud#3051 (p1, cloud lane). Q2–Q4 below, read on objectstack `origin/main` `44a5011fe623` and cloud `9099bd1ea646`; each claim carries its anchor.

### Common ground, measured
- None of the four tables declares `organization_id` or a tenancy setting; all four receive the injected column (census `scripts/platform-object-tenancy-census.json`: `sys_activity` `:48`–`:53`, `sys_email` `:167`–`:172`, `sys_secret` `:572`–`:577`, `sys_setting_audit` `:595`–`:600`, each `reach: "in"`).
- None is in `PLATFORM_OBJECT_TENANCY` (`packages/objectql/src/tenancy/platform-object-tenancy.ts:124`–`:229`); they classify `unclassified` (`:244`–`:246`), which puts them out of the tenant audit scope (`:261`–`:264`) and makes `engine.ts:7183` return before D9's refuse-or-derive step. So today an organisation-less system insert passes in every posture (pin `tenancy-by-object-classification.test.ts:205`); the refusal the card fears begins when stage 8b classifies them. The epic's order (8b-0c… before 8b) is right.
- No RLS policy in `default-permission-sets.ts` names any of the four; Layer 0 (`plugin-security/src/tenant-layer.ts:66`–`:91`) walls member reads, system reads are not walled.
- ADR-0131 names only `sys_email` (D7 `:502`–`:508`); `sys_activity`, `sys_secret` and `sys_setting_audit` appear nowhere in it. No 「Not touched」 list exists in ADR-0131 (the card's phrase comes from #15194's body).
- Ceremony: all four have fate `attribution` (`cli/src/utils/organization-ownership-inventory.ts:518`, `:521`, `:596`, `:597`); under a wall their organisation-less rows are `unattributable` (`organization-ownership-plan.ts:1217`–`:1226`) and, since stage 8c-0 (#24403), block certification (`organization-ownership-apply.ts:2899`–`:2902`). So each answer below must also say what the ceremony does with the rows that already exist.
- Cloud's framework pin (`ec749fbb`, #24320) predates PR #24369; cloud keeps its own platform-global list (`packages/service-cloud/src/control-plane-platform-global.ts`).

### Q2 · `sys_email` — identity mail is deployment-level: **A confirmed, with its shape named**
- One writer (`plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts:446`–`:448`, SYSTEM_CTX); the organisation is whatever the producer passes (`email-service.ts:742`–`:749`, `:866`–`:883`); the contract says to omit it 「when the caller genuinely has none (auth verification / password-reset mail)」 (`spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts:79`–`:81`). Identity senders in `plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` (verify `:2092`, reset `:2029`, account invitation `:2014`, magic link `:4114`, email change `:5817`) pass `derivableWriteOrganizationId` (`:5638`–`:5646`): the Default Organization under `single`, null under a wall. Tenant mail is stamped by its producer (`auth.invitation` `:3880`–`:3882`; the messaging channel `service-messaging/src/email-channel.ts:345`, `:385`).
- No reader filters `sys_email` by organisation; plugin-email reads by id or status under SYSTEM_CTX (`email-plugin.ts:741`, `:812`; `outbox-sweep.ts:180`; `attachment-reclaim.ts:202`). Members never see these rows through the wall.
- D7 `:502`–`:508` keeps `sys_email` tenant data because producers stamp it (#11303 decision 2, the maintainer's 2026-08-24 word 「sys_email 应该写 organization_id」) — A amends that for identity mail only, as the card says.
- **Shape that fits the record's third sentence:** un-mix by producer — tenant mail stays in `sys_email` (NOT NULL); identity mail goes to a deployment-level sibling with no organisation column (one object, same row shape), served by the same outbox / status / attachment pipeline (the pipeline reads by id and status, so it is one more table to sweep, not a second pipeline). Not 「a nullable column for identity mail」 (the third shape D7 refuses) and not 「don't persist identity mail」 (verification and reset need the outbox's delivery guarantees).
- Ceremony: existing walled rows whose anchor is `sys_user` (verify, reset) or none (magic link) are the identity rows — they move to the sibling, not to an organisation.
- Cloud lane: `apps/cloud/test/unscoped-control-plane-tenant-wall.test.ts:5538`, `:5564`–`:5584` uses NULL-organisation verification mails as its non-vacuity control and must be rewritten against the sibling; `sys_email` was taken off cloud's platform-global list at v18 for the opposite reason (`control-plane-platform-global.ts:69`–`:72`, invitation mail failing when the table had no column at all) — that stays, since tenant mail keeps the column.
- Fallback B (derive the recipient's one membership) cannot cover verification mail (no membership yet); C breaks sign-up. **A holds.**

### Q3 · `sys_activity` — activity only for records that carry an organisation: **A confirmed, in the form 「skip, never null」**
- One platform producer, the CRUD mirror (`plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts:1170`–`:1181`, `api.sudo()`): organisation = the record's, else the session's (`:1995`), else `derivableActivityOrganization()` (the Default Organisation under `single`), else an explicit null (`:2230`–`:2231`). `SKIP_OBJECTS` (`:203`…) does not list `sys_user`, `sys_email`, `sys_secret`, `sys_setting_audit`, `sys_platform_setting` or `sys_user_permission_set`, so a sign-up writes 12 null rows under a wall (#24369's measurement).
- Reads: a row is readable iff its parent record is (`activity-read-visibility.ts:3`–`:5`, `:48`–`:51`); Layer 0 applies on top. Cloud reads the stream on hosted record pages (`apps/objectos/hosted-slate.ts:132`) and grants it in AI Studio (`member-access.ts:105`, `:162`); its control plane calls `sys_activity` tenant data (`control-plane-platform-global.ts:102`–`:105`).
- Two dogfood tests read activity about `sys_user` rows as an organisation member (`identity-admin-fields-org-peer.dogfood.test.ts:179`, `:225`, showcase boot, `single`).
- **The form that keeps `single` whole:** the mirror writes a row when an organisation is derivable (the record's, the session's, the Default Organisation under `single`) and otherwise writes nothing — never a null row. Under a wall, activity about a record with no organisation (a sign-up's `sys_user`, a global setting) has no activity row; the deployment ledger (`sys_audit_log`, D7) keeps the record. Under `single` nothing changes (the two dogfood tests keep passing). Cost about the card's 0.1–0.2k lines.
- Ceremony: existing null rows are telemetry with a 14-day rotation (`sys-activity.object.ts:29`–`:34`); they are deleted, not attributed.
- B (the actor's organisation) is null at sign-up; C is the recurring audit error. **A holds, as 「skip, never null」.**

### Q4 · `sys_secret` and `sys_setting_audit` — **A confirmed for both; one premise of #24369 corrected**
- `sys_secret` (`platform-objects/src/system/sys-secret.object.ts`, `engine-owned`, `access: { default: 'private' }` `:53`): three producers — SettingsService stamps an organisation only for tenant / user scoped values and all 17 encrypted specifiers are `scope: 'global'` (`settings-service.ts:2087`, `:2112`–`:2124`); the engine's `encryptSecretFields` (`engine.ts:10671`, `:10733`–`:10746`) writes through the business write's driver options, so **organisation-scoped secret rows are written today** for `sys_webhook` secrets (`sys-webhook.object.ts:220`, `:253`), `sys_flow_credential.value` (`:100`) and app `Field.secret` fields (pin `deployment-level-no-tenant-column.test.ts:80`–`:87`) — this corrects #24369's line 「No webhook producer writes sys_secret」, which the epic seat should note on #24343; the datasource binder writes none (`datasource-secret-binder.ts:119`–`:127`). Every read is by id under privilege (`engine.resolveSecret` `:11007`–`:11017`; the binder `:141`; the CLI `secret orphans` / `rewrap` scan raw); no read filters by organisation; the encryption AAD covers scope, namespace and key, not the organisation (`local-crypto-provider.ts:82`–`:84`). So the column carries no security and no reader; 「ownership follows the referencing row」 is already how every consumer behaves. Cloud keeps the table 403 to everyone and reads it under SYSTEM (`control-plane-platform-global.ts:88`–`:92`), keys per environment; its v18 move copies handles unchanged (`control-plane-v18-move.ts:34`). **A holds; dropping the column is a declaration of what the code does.** Ceremony: anchors `[]` today (`:597`); with the column gone there is nothing to attribute.
- `sys_setting_audit` (`sys-setting-audit.object.ts`, `engine-owned`, rungs global / tenant / user `:72`–`:83`): one producer stamps an organisation only for tenant / user rows (`settings-service.ts:2203`–`:2212`, `settings-service-plugin.ts:600`–`:615`); readers apply a namespace predicate, never an organisation filter (`settings-read-door.ts:43`–`:73`). `sys_setting` already has a departure that moves its global rung to `sys_platform_setting` (inventory `:586`–`:594`); the audit table has none. **A = the same departure for the audit's global rung** — a deployment-level sibling for global-rung audit rows, tenant / user rows stay. Cloud declares the whole table platform-global with no column (`control-plane-platform-global.ts:132`–`:137`) and withdrew the organisation-admin read (`control-plane-permissions.ts:431`–`:447`); under A cloud converges to the platform's split (cloud lane). **A holds.** Ceremony: existing global-rung rows move to the sibling.
- B (keep them tenant tables, declare platform-global per deployment) is what cloud does by hand today; A makes the platform declare it once. C (split by producer) multiplies tables.

### What this changes in the recommendation
Nothing in the letters: **Q1 A (after cloud#3051) · Q2 A · Q3 A · Q4 A.** Three refinements go into the stages: Q2's shape (an identity-mail sibling on the shared pipeline), Q3's form (skip, never null; `single` unchanged), Q4's corrected premise (engine-written organisation-scoped secrets exist and keep their owning row). Cloud-lane items, filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat at each stage's landing: the wall test's control (Q2), the platform-global list converging to the platform's declarations (Q4), cloud#3051 (Q1).

**How mainstream multi-tenant platforms classify the four kinds of rows** (the seat's reading; confidence noted):
- **Identity mail to the person (Q2).** Auth0, Okta, Clerk, Supabase Auth and better-auth itself send verification / reset / magic-link mail from the identity layer; the message is not a record of any customer tenant, and where it is logged (Auth0 tenant logs) it is logged at the identity layer's level, not under the application's organisations. Salesforce stores `EmailMessage` only for org business mail; platform mail (password reset) leaves no org record. Confidence: high. ⇒ identity mail is deployment-level by every reference model.
- **Activity on organisation-less records (Q3).** Salesforce's Setup Audit Trail and Login History are org-level (deployment-level in our terms) ledgers, separate from record feeds; Dataverse auditing is per environment with a system audit log distinct from record activity; ServiceNow domain separation puts records with no domain in the `global` domain, visible to global admins only, and the activity stream is per record. Confidence: medium-high. ⇒ a tenant activity stream carries only tenant records; the rest belongs to the deployment ledger (`sys_audit_log`, D7).
- **Deployment-level secrets and global settings (Q4).** Salesforce Named Credentials / Protected Custom Settings and Dataverse environment variables (secrets) are environment-level objects with no business-record owner; ServiceNow `sys_properties` are instance-level (domain-separable when a property is explicitly domain-scoped); Stripe keeps platform and connected-account keys in different objects. Confidence: high. ⇒ a secret belongs to the thing that references it; global settings and their audit are deployment-level.
- **Self-registration grant (Q1).** Salesforce has no self-service user creation into an org without an admin (or a community/experience site with a profile assigned at creation — the grant is created WITH the membership); Auth0/Okta organisations assign roles on membership; Dataverse assigns security roles when a user is added to an environment. Confidence: high. ⇒ the grant travels with the first membership — A's shape — and the pre-membership window carries no grant anywhere in the mainstream; what the console shows in that window is the product's own design question (cloud#3051 measures it).

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:A·A·A·A 不变 —— 四条都是「没有组织列的表是部署级,靠权限不靠墙」;Q2 用「按生产者拆表、共用投递管线」,Q3 用「可推导才写、绝不写空」,Q4 把 cloud 今天手工做的事变成平台声明。
- ② 实际业务拉动:带墙注册每次都撞上;仪式自 8c-0 起对无主行阻断认证,所以现存行的去向必须随字母一起定(Q2 搬到兄弟表、Q3 删、Q4 去列或搬)。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:每条仍是一句结构性规则;#24369「没有 webhook 生产者写 sys_secret」这条前提已证伪,记给史诗席,避免 8b 阶段按错前提建。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:四条都是减法;Q2、Q4 各需一次 D7 修订(Tier H)。

自检:只看①选 A·A·A·A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

Ruling: batch #366 item 1 · letters Q1 A · Q2 A · Q3 A · Q4 A · maintainer 「同意」 then 「24377 按照你的建议」 2026-10-19T01:09Z

Director seat, summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`, on the epic PM's decision card (A · A · A · A recommended; the director deltas 6256868584 and 6257256417, the second with the Q2–Q4 source reading and the mainstream comparison) (opening marker objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708, comment 6247058702). The maintainer's words in this session's chat: 「24377 需要的话，Q1 你现在就可以派测试 ，cloud 相关任务加到cloud车道。 其他Q问题也帮我深度调研和分析确认。」, then 「同意」, then 「24377 按照你的建议」.

**What the ruling binds (each a C8 stage before 8b, under 3,000 lines, measured first; the epic seat cuts them):**
1. **Q1 A — the self-registration grant settles on the first membership.** `settleSelfRegistrationGrant` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:5670`) grants `sys_user_permission_set` when the user joins or creates their first organisation (creating is joining as owner), under every posture; no deployment-level grant (D3 stands). Dispatched only after objectstack-ai/cloud#3051 reports: the walled window between sign-up and the first organisation is the cloud seat's measurement; a console read that needs a set in that window becomes a cloud card, not a reason to keep the grant at sign-up. Fallback B only if cloud#3051 shows that creating the first organisation itself needs the set.
2. **Q2 A — identity mail is deployment-level, by un-mixing.** Tenant mail stays in `sys_email` (NOT NULL organisation); identity mail (verify, reset, magic link, email change, an account invitation to a person with no organisation) goes to a deployment-level sibling object with no organisation column and the same row shape, served by the same outbox / status / attachment pipeline (one more table for `plugin-email`'s by-id and by-status reads). Not a nullable column; not 「no persistence」. ADR-0131 D7 `:502`–`:508` is amended by a dated line (Tier H, the maintainer merges): #11303 decision 2 keeps tenant mail stamped; identity mail is the sibling's. Ceremony: existing walled rows anchored on `sys_user` or on nothing move to the sibling. Cloud lane: the wall test's non-vacuity control (`apps/cloud/test/unscoped-control-plane-tenant-wall.test.ts:5538`, `:5564`–`:5584`) is rewritten against the sibling.
3. **Q3 A — activity is written when an organisation is derivable, otherwise not at all; never a null row.** The CRUD mirror (`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts:1170`–`:1181`, `:2230`–`:2231`) keeps its derivation (the record's organisation, the session's, the Default Organisation under `single`) and skips the row when none is derivable. Under `single` nothing changes; under a wall a record with no organisation has no activity row and the deployment ledger (`sys_audit_log`, D7) keeps the change. Ceremony: existing null rows are deleted (14-day telemetry). Cloud's hosted activity stream and AI Studio grants are unaffected.
4. **Q4 A — `sys_secret` drops its organisation column; the settings audit's global rung moves to a deployment-level sibling.** `sys_secret`: ownership follows the referencing row (`sys_setting` / `sys_platform_setting`, the webhook, the flow credential, the field's record, the datasource); every read stays by id under privilege; `access: { default: 'private' }` stays; the engine's `encryptSecretFields` path keeps writing — PR #24369's premise 「no webhook producer writes sys_secret」 is corrected: `sys_webhook`, `sys_flow_credential` and `Field.secret` rows exist (`deployment-level-no-tenant-column.test.ts:80`–`:87`) — now without the column. `sys_setting_audit`: the departure `sys_setting` already has — global-rung rows to a deployment-level sibling, tenant / user rows stay (NOT NULL). D7 amended by a dated line in the same Tier H PR as Q2. Ceremony: nothing to attribute for secrets; global-rung audit rows move to the sibling. Cloud lane: `packages/service-cloud/src/control-plane-platform-global.ts` converges to the platform's declarations (`:88`–`:92`, `:132`–`:137`).
5. **Order:** Q3 first (smallest); Q1 after cloud#3051; Q2 and Q4 with the D7 PR; 8b then lifts the exemption in every posture; 8c and 8e follow the plan 6251466182.

Not taken: the B / C variants (exception lists, refusals of normal sign-up, a per-deployment platform-global list kept by hand).

**Workload of the letter:** the card's figures — Q1 0.3–0.6k, Q2 0.5–1k, Q3 0.1–0.2k, Q4 0.8–1.5k lines — plus one Tier H ADR PR.

**Execution:** pointer on #15212 (the C8 plan) for the epic seat; pointer on #24343 for the corrected premise; the cloud items are on objectstack-ai/cloud#1979 (6257262727) and cloud#3051; this card leaves `needs-user-decision` and closes `completed`.

Closed `completed` · ruled Q1 A · Q2 A · Q3 A · Q4 A at 6257510973 (batch #366 item 1, the maintainer's 「同意」 then 「24377 按照你的建议」) · director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) · 2026-10-19T01:12Z

Four C8 stages before 8b, cut by the epic seat (pointer 6257530319 on #15212): Q3 first; Q1 after objectstack-ai/cloud#3051; Q2 and Q4 with one Tier H ADR-0131 D7 PR. The corrected #24369 premise is on #24343 (6257536700); the cloud-lane items are on cloud#1979 (6257262727).

Consumer pointer from `repo:cloud#2` (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145) · `os-zhuang` · session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX` · 2026-10-19T01:57Z · ⛔ Not a claim. No reply is owed. **For Q1:** cloud's measurement (objectstack-ai/cloud#3051, report `6258001191`).

**Cloud's control plane tolerates Q1 A as it is.** On a local walled stack at cloud's pins (framework `ec749fbb`), a registrant whose self-registration grant was withheld walked sign-up → 创建组织 → switcher → home with the same requests, statuses and screens as one holding the grant. Creating the organisation needs no permission set.

- **Why:** cloud declares the self-registration set `cloud_control_plane_member` as its `isDefault` baseline too (`packages/service-cloud/src/control-plane-permissions.ts:137`, `control-plane-preset.ts:619`, `:776`). So every authenticated human already holds it through ADR-0090 D5's additive baseline, and the grant row duplicates it.
- **What cloud owes Q1 A:** one test re-pin, by the pin bump that carries it (`apps/cloud/test/unscoped-control-plane-tenant-wall.test.ts:2453-2455`).
- **Q1 B** (no grant ever) is already what invited members get on cloud, and it works. **Q1 C** (a deployment-level grant) is moot on this plane. For cloud, the letter can be chosen on framework grounds.
